name: More & More (Moremore)
source:
A formerly prestigious theater club is in danger of dissolving now. Main character becomes the club's adviser and organizes recruiting, but in the end, the club is left with only two members. The dreams of setting a Shakespeare play become impossible, so they have to settle with Little Red Riding Hood imitation. However, both member girls are so bad at acting. Protagonist needs to give them individual training sessions to attain relaxed scene behavior.

[Edited From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个曾经声名显赫的戏剧社正濒临解散。
主人公担任社团顾问并组织招新，最终却只剩下两名社员。
上演莎士比亚剧目的梦想因此破灭，只能改演《小红帽》的仿作。
然而两名女社员的演技都糟糕透顶。
为了让她们在场景中表现得更放松，主人公必须分别对她们进行训练。

[改编自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
